# Stat

`stats/stat` &middot; content-level &middot; category: stats

## Purpose

One statistic: a big value, a label and an optional note.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | text |  |
| `label` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Display-size accent value with a label.
- **plain**: Value in the normal text color. Sets `valueColor: @colors.text`.
- **compact**: Smaller h1-size value. Sets `valueLevel: h1`.
- **left**: Left-aligned. Sets `align: left`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `valueLevel` | one of `display`, `h1`, `h2` | `"display"` |
| `valueColor` | text | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `labelColor` | text | `"auto"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and colors honored. | Fine. | Label swaps via dm-text where honored. The value keeps its color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('stats/stat', {
  "value": "98%",
  "label": "Customer satisfaction",
  "note": "From 2,140 verified reviews"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "stats/stat",
  "data": {
    "value": "98%",
    "label": "Customer satisfaction",
    "note": "From 2,140 verified reviews"
  }
}
```
